{{Top|leg}}
'''Efflan Jor''' was a member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] during the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]]. He reprimanded [[Pree Bandari]] for losing the access codes to the [[Hutt Embassy]] in [[Talaos City]] and provided Bandri with a new set of codes on a strict condition that they would be memorized and the original message deleted.
